subject: Orbit enablement: stakeholder sprint plan & exception routing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit enablement: stakeholder sprint plan & exception routing

Team —

As we edge toward the Orbit feature activation (targeting 2027-07-12), I want to align a short, tactical sprint to close docs, enablement, and exception handling so we don't get blocked at rollout. Attached is a rough scope and proposed timeline. Key asks below: 

1) Docs and train-the-trainer: who will own the developer quickstart, the admin runbook, and the customer-facing release notes? I propose: Dev quickstart (Aditya), Admin runbook (Kimberly), Release notes & customer comms (Vanessa).

2) Exceptions & gating: we need an exception routing matrix for three classes — data policy (security/compliance), perf regressions, and UX/data-migration. Tessa, can you steward the exception rota and an on-call handoff doc?

3) Canary & rollback path: Jonas, can you confirm the canary slice cadence and whether we can support a 1-hour rollback SLA for the first 48 hours?

4) Stakeholder sprint: propose a focused 5-day work sprint (06/28–07/02) for docs, one-run training, and dry-run of the rollback. Deliverables: updated quickstart, runbook, exception matrix, and a 45m internal walkthrough slot.

Please reply with ownership confirmations and any blockers by EOD Wed 06/23. I added a Drive link in attachments with the current draft.

Attachments: Orbit-Enablement-Scope-v1.2.pdf; Stakeholder-Map.gdoc-link.txt

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. PM, Product Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit enablement: stakeholder sprint plan & exception routing

Marissa — thanks for the clear ask. Confirming the ownership split works for me (I will own the admin runbook). A couple of clarifying points / blockers I see: 

- Dependencies: I need the final infra config (KV cache settings + quantization profile) from infra by 06/25 to write accurate operational runbooks. Aditya: can you confirm the config freeze date?
- Readiness gating metrics: propose we measure three gates: mean p99 latency delta (vs baseline), token-cost delta, and error-rate increase. Can we commit to owners for those three metrics?
- Training slots: we will need at least two internal walkthroughs (07/05 and 07/09) to cover support and SRE. Vanessa — will you coordinate calendar invites?

Attachment: I added a small checklist to the Drive doc for runbook sections.

Kimberly Park
Principal PM, Ops Documentation
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit enablement: stakeholder sprint plan & exception routing

Quick update — I will own the exception rota and create the Exception-Routing-Template.csv. Plan:

- Create routing rows for Data Policy, Performance, Migration, and Third-party-integrations. Columns: trigger, initial owner, escalation owner, required PO approvals, and rollback threshold.
- Populate with existing on-call contacts and primary/secondary owners by 06/24.
- I recommend we include the DocOps partner (docops@partners.co) for any contract/signoff steps that require partner playbook changes; I'll loop them in as needed.

I'll drop the template in the Drive link and flag any missing owners.

Tessa Morgan
Launch Lead, Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit enablement: stakeholder sprint plan & exception routing

+1 on the plan. Quick answers from my side: 

- Canary cadence: we can do progressive slices (1% -> 5% -> 25%) over the first 6 hours with a hold at each step for 45 minutes of telemetry review. That's workable provided we have the perf metrics streaming to the Release Dashboard.
- 1-hour rollback SLA: doable for the first 48 hours if SRE owns the rollback trigger and somebody from infra is on pager for KV cache invalidation. Aditya, can you confirm SRE coverage and whether infra will commit a 1-hr rollback window?
- Impact to dependent releases: INF-3472 needs to be merged before the canary step; I linked the ticket below.

Related: https://drive.redwood/company/enablement/orbit-scope-v1.2  (see section 3.2, 'Canary & Rollback')

Jonas Weber
Staff Engineer, Release Orchestration
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@acme-platform.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit enablement: stakeholder sprint plan & exception routing

Thanks, all — summary and decisions so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions / owners:
- Dev quickstart: Aditya (deliver draft 06/28)
- Admin runbook: Kimberly (final by 07/02)
- Release notes & customer comms: Vanessa (draft by 06/30)
- Exception rota & template: Tessa (template ready 06/24; populated by 06/25)
- Canary & rollback: Jonas + SRE (canary plan in INF-3472; rollback SLA 1-hr first 48h)

Blockers / actions:
- Aditya to confirm infra config freeze and SRE coverage by EOD 06/23 (Aditya: please reply)
- Kimberly to add gating metrics to Drive doc (p99 delta, token-cost delta, error-rate) by 06/25
- Vanessa to send invites for internal walkthroughs (07/05, 07/09) and share customer-facing timeline with Liam by 06/30
Attachments added to Drive: Orbit-Enablement-Scope-v1.2.pdf, Exception-Routing-Template.csv, Stakeholder-Map.gdoc-link.txt

Liam — looping you in so Acme Platform sees the proposed timeline. If you have any contractual review needs or partner playbook asks, flag them and we will include DocOps.

I'll run the stakeholder sprint 06/28–07/02 as planned and circulate the final checklist on 07/03. If anything changes before then, call it out here.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. PM, Product Enablement
Redwood Inference
